title: kopsia schultzii
intro: Kopsia schultzii, commonly known as the Kopsia tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Kopsia schultzii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms of various diseases.
